## 页面标题
**Mature Product/PMS Overview – INFL (Nerandomilast)**

## 表格字段（表头）
- Product/Study
- Indication
- Study type (Study no.: FPI-LPO, CTR)
- Current Status
- Next Milestone
- Key Updates

---

## 各项目可见内容（按行）

### 1) Nerandomilast PROFINA（Xiehe Hospital, Prof. XUZuojun）
- 适应症：PPF  
- 研究类型：ECR（1305-0105; Oct2025-Jul2028, Dec2028）
- 当前状态：FPI（23Sep 2025）
- 下一里程碑：LPI（Jul 2026）
- 关键更新：
  - FPI: 23Sep 2025
  - Enrollment: 5/600（actual/plan）；site: 1/30（initiated/plan）
  - The newCRO was onboard, and the study timeline is under assessment.

### 2) Nerandomilast ILDEP1（Zhongguancun Big Data, Prof. ZHOUMaigen）
- 适应症：ILD  
- 研究类型：ECR（1305-0111; May 2025-Aug 2025, Sep 2026）
- 当前状态：Data analysis of part 1&2（30Sep 2025）
- 下一里程碑：Data analysis of part 3（Jun 2026）
- 关键更新：
  - The Part3 is ongoing.

### 3) Nerandomilast（Non-interventional study based on existing data: claims data of Beijing）（Binhai, Prof. YIN Peng）
- 适应症：IPF  
- 研究类型：ECR（Jun 2026-Jan 2027, Sep 2027）
- 当前状态：PEC approval（Nov 2025）
- 下一里程碑：Global approval（Mar 2026）
- 关键更新：
  - PEC endorsed on 17Nov 2025.
  - Hybrid review was completed on 25Feb 2026, and the results is approved with comments.
  - All reviews approved in Lectrona and waiting for GMA to complete the MM of global release in Lectrona.

### 4) Nerandomilast（Exploring patients’ experiences with nerandomilast: a longitudinal qualitative research among IPF patients）（Peking University Third Hospital, Prof. CHU Hongjing）
- 适应症：IPF  
- 研究类型：ECR（TBD）
- 当前状态：TBD
- 下一里程碑：TBD
- 关键更新：
  - Offline preparation and discussion on proposal before CEC
  - Adhoc CEC 0413

### 5) Epidemiology and Disease Burden of Systemic Sclerosis (SSc) in Beijing: A Study Based on the Beijing Claims Database（Peking University Third Hospital, Prof. ZHUO Lin）
- 适应症：SSc  
- 研究类型：ECR（TBD）
- 当前状态：TBD
- 下一里程碑：TBD
- 关键更新：
  - Offline preparation and discussion on proposal before CEC
  - Adhoc CEC 0413

### 6) Nerandomilast（Serum Exosome Combined with Radiomics to Predict Early Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis）（The first affiliated hospital of Guangzhou medical university, Prof. HAN Qian）
- 适应症：PPF  
- 研究类型：ECR（1305-0123）（Dec2025-Dec2027, Jun2028）
- 当前状态：Amendment EC approval
- 下一里程碑：LPI（Dec 2026）
- 关键更新：
  - FPI completed on 20Oct 2025
  - Enrollment progress: 178(+24)/325（actual/plan）, till 16 Mar 2026;

### 7) Multimodal for detection of early IPF（Shanghai Chest Hospital, Prof. LI Feng）
- 适应症：IPF  
- 研究类型：IIS（1305-0161）（Jul2018-July2026, July2027）
- 当前状态：Protocol approval（Apr 2026）
- 下一里程碑：Contract（Nov 2026）
- 关键更新：
  - CEC approval on 1 Sep 2025
  - Global proposal approved on 3 Nov 2025
  - Proposal released on 24 Nov 2025
  - Protocol approval on 12 Feb 2026
  - Contract awaiting the investigator’s first-round feedback.

### 8) Biomarker Changes in High-Risk IIM-ILD Patients Treated with Nera plus IS（Renji hospital, Prof. YE Shuang）
- 适应症：IIM-ILD  
- 研究类型：IIS（TBD）
- 当前状态：Proposal submit（Feb2026）
- 下一里程碑：Proposal release（May2026）
- 关键更新：
  - PEC approval on 20260209
  - Proposal submit on 0317 and was locally approved on 0318.
  - Global proposal approve and release process.
  - AMP applied in Mar by email from MA
